name: SolderSight Bench QC
brief: Build a benchtop PCB quality-control camera board: a two-layer 60x40 mm board built around an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 (N8R8, 8 MB flash, 8 MB PSRAM) with a DVP camera connector for an OV2640 module (24-pin 0.5 mm FPC, matching the XIAO ESP32S3 Sense camera wiring), a ring of 8 WS2812B addressable RGB LEDs for illumination and status, and a microSD card slot for storing known-good reference images. Power from USB-C (CC1/CC2 5.1k pulldowns, ESD protection), a 3.3 V LDO (at least 600 mA) feeding the module, camera and LEDs, with a bulk 100 uF plus decoupling per rail. LED data line through a 330 ohm series resistor; camera I2C (SDA/SCL) with 4.7k pull-ups; boot strapping (GPIO0 button, EN 10k pull-up + 1 uF to ground); 3.3 V only on strapping-relevant inputs. Expose TX/RX on a 4-pin header (3V3, TX, RX, GND) next to the boot and reset buttons. Ground pour on both layers, antenna end of the module clear of copper (keepout at least 5 mm on all layers, antenna overhanging the board edge). Silkscreen: board name SolderSight Bench QC, LED ring center marked, fiducials in opposing corners.
